```ruby
class LinkPolicy
  def self.external?(url)
    uri = URI.parse(url.to_s)
    scheme = Rails.configuration.x.use_https ? 'https' : 'http'
    local_domains = [Rails.configuration.x.local_domain, Rails.configuration.x.web_domain].uniq

    local_domains.none? do |domain|
      local = URI.parse("#{scheme}://#{domain}")
      local.host.casecmp?(uri.host.to_s) && local.port == uri.port
    end
  rescue URI::InvalidURIError
    true
  end
end
```

```ruby
class LinkPolicy
  def self.external?(url)
    uri = Addressable::URI.parse(url).normalize
    return true unless uri.host

    local = Addressable::URI.parse("#{Rails.configuration.x.use_https ? 'https' : 'http'}://#{Rails.configuration.x.local_domain}").normalize

  rescue Addressable::URI::InvalidURIError, IDN::Idna::IdnaError
    true
  end
end
```
